title: One administrator role
summary: Admin is now the only admin role. Admins can use every Admin page, including Access, Plugins, Emails and Maintenance. Super Admin no longer exists.
changes: Give the Admin role everything Super Admin could do: Access, group mappings, job roles, permissions, plugins, maintenance and email wording.
Remove the Super Admin role and its separate permission. Existing Super Admin accounts become Admin accounts automatically.
Treat the Cloudron myapesaccount.superadmin group as the Admin group until it is deleted, so sign-in works with or without it.
Let Admins manage other Admins, while still blocking changes to their own account and keeping at least one active Admin.
Keep old /superadmin addresses as permanent redirects to Admin.
Remove the Super Admin option from the local QA role switcher.
version_rationale: Minor: removes a protected role and changes who can open Admin pages, with a data migration.
validation: Full PHPUnit suite, including a new upgrade test that starts from a Super Admin database and the previous database guard.
Upgrade and guard tests on MySQL 8.
Local browser check of the Admin pages as the QA Admin account.
known_limitations: The Cloudron myapesaccount.superadmin group still exists until it is removed by hand (issue #462).
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package and restore the pre-deploy database backup. The migration merges Super Admin into Admin and is not reversed automatically.
provenance: Milestone v0.46.3 Beta, issue #459 under epic #458, pull request #576.
